announcements.title: Announcements
announcements.intro: Learners see these as a banner on their dashboard, in their language. Push messages follow once push notifications are connected.
announcements.sent: Announcement saved. Learners see it when they next open the app.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.intro: Every admin action, newest first. Entries can't be changed or deleted.

marking.title: Mark writing
marking.intro: Checkpoint writing from your learners, oldest first. Reading and listening are already scored by the server; your mark completes the result.

readiness.title: Ready for the exam
readiness.intro: Learners who passed a level checkpoint, for exam nomination. The date range applies to when they passed.

checkpoints.title: Checkpoint tests
checkpoints.intro: One checkpoint per level, taken online at the end of the level (FR-404). Each attempt draws questions from these banks; answers stay on the server. Speaking is added when pronunciation scoring is connected.
checkpoints.listeningHint: Every listening question needs a recording.
checkpoints.writingHint: A trainer marks writing with the guide below.
